purpose: Trace public benchmark sources reviewed while adding the business-goal agent evaluation layer.
download_policy: Commit lightweight public README/evaluation-guide artifacts only. Keep large PDFs, Docker images, full datasets, and restricted examples out of git.

sources.name: AgentBench
sources.agent_peak_bench_usage: Use as a reference for multi-environment coverage, but keep Agent Peak Bench focused on harness decisions and business deployment guidance.

sources.name: WebArena
sources.agent_peak_bench_usage: Reuse the idea of end-state success instead of answer-only grading for enterprise web workflows.

sources.name: SWE-bench
useful_patterns: dataset variants for iteration versus high-quality evaluation
sources.agent_peak_bench_usage: Reuse executable verification and dataset-tier thinking for coding and harness-engineering scenarios.

sources.name: tau-bench
sources.agent_peak_bench_usage: Directly informs pass@k/pass^k, policy-bound tool use, and repeatability requirements.

sources.name: OSWorld
sources.agent_peak_bench_usage: Use for computer-use and MCP-tool side-effect evaluation, especially where browser-only tasks are insufficient.

sources.name: WorkArena
sources.agent_peak_bench_usage: Use as a reference for enterprise workflow realism, but extend with business-goal decomposition and harness recommendations.

sources.name: TheAgentCompany
sources.agent_peak_bench_usage: Use as the strongest reference for business-like agent tasks; Agent Peak Bench adds model-specific cookbook and vendor feedback outputs.

sources.name: Terminal-Bench
sources.agent_peak_bench_usage: Use verification-script thinking for CLI, DevOps, data, and repo tasks.

sources.name: PaperBench
sources.agent_peak_bench_usage: Use hierarchical rubrics for business-goal decomposition and long-horizon model capability reports.

sources.name: BrowseComp / simple-evals
sources.agent_peak_bench_usage: Use search perseverance and anti-leakage principles; do not publish dataset examples.

sources.name: Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard
sources.agent_peak_bench_usage: Use as the low-level tool-call quality reference beneath business workflow tasks.
